# Tagcast 1.9.0

Tagcast 1.9.0 adds desktop update downloads and confirmed installation for
supported installations, and puts the Change history actions above the entries.
The editor, player and iBroadcast save protocol remain shared with the browser
version.

## Read release notes and choose when to update

- A newer stable release can show its GitHub release notes inside Tagcast. Notes
  are displayed as bounded plain text, without running HTML or loading embedded
  images. The official release page remains available for complete notes and
  manual downloads.
- Supported installed copies offer **Download update**, download progress,
  **Restart and install**, **Later** and **Skip this version**. Opening the dialog
  does not download a package or interrupt playback.
- Optional automatic downloading is off for a new profile. Its preference and
  skipped version stay in the local desktop profile. The existing automatic
  release-check setting remains separate; an explicit check can still show a
  skipped release.
- Installation needs an additional native confirmation. Ordinary Quit never
  installs a downloaded update. Existing unsaved-draft prompts remain, and
  accepted writes, read-back checks and local storage finish before installation.
  Uncertain work postpones installation rather than being force-terminated or
  retried.
- Package metadata is pinned to this repository, a stable version and the exact
  platform filenames. Downloads are checked against SHA-512 package digests.
  Update requests do not send iBroadcast credentials, library records or track
  metadata, and no persistent staged-rollout identifier is sent to GitHub.

## Upgrade from 1.8.0

**Install 1.9.0 once through the normal download or package-manager route.**
Tagcast 1.8.0 does not contain the new installer and cannot install this first
updater-enabled version itself. Quit the old application or terminal server
before replacing its package. Existing settings, sign-in data and library caches
remain in their normal folders.

From 1.9.0, the route for a later stable update depends on the installation:

| Installation | Update route |
|---|---|
| Developer ID signed macOS app, Apple Silicon or Intel | Download in Tagcast, then explicitly confirm replacement and restart. |
| Homebrew-managed macOS app | Keep `brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask cyberdeliaAI/apps/tagcast`. |
| Installed Debian/Ubuntu package | Download in Tagcast, then approve the package installer's privilege request. |
| Windows installer or portable ZIP | Manual update while Windows signing remains pending. |
| Linux TAR.GZ, source/browser, ad-hoc test app or a reused backend | Manual update through the appropriate download or source route. |

A new per-user Windows NSIS installer is supplied alongside the portable ZIP.
Both Windows downloads remain unsigned; this release does not enable in-app
Windows installation or bypass signature verification.

See [Desktop update installation](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/main/docs/desktop-updates.md)
for platform detection, recovery and the validation required before the first
subsequent in-app update chain.

## Change history actions are easier to reach

**Export changes** and **Clear change history…** now appear directly below the
Change history heading, above a long list of changes. The clear confirmation and
Cancel button appear there too.

Export still creates the same browser-local JSON record. Clearing still needs
confirmation, remains blocked during saves/read-back, and removes only the local
history and its Undo information. It does not undo anything saved to iBroadcast.

## Documentation and downloads

- The [Wiki](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki) describes the update routes
  and the History controls. New 1.9.0 screenshots cover playback, lyrics, album
  browsing and information, themes, first setup, Overview, 1001 Albums and a
  visualization. Older screenshot sets and PDF editions remain available with
  their original version labels.
- Downloads cover macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64, Linux x64 and
  Debian/Ubuntu. Every application package has a SHA-256 companion. The update
  feeds describe the same verified packages with SHA-512 digests.
- Production macOS packages are Developer ID signed and notarized. Final archive
  extraction, stapling and Gatekeeper checks, native application smoke tests,
  Windows installer checks, Debian installation/removal and distribution
  verification gate publication.
- Electron remains pinned to 44.11.0. Python source use requires 3.11 or newer;
  desktop downloads bundle Python. No music files are retagged by this release.

## Known limitations

- Windows downloads are not code-signed; Windows in-app installation remains
  disabled until trusted signing is integrated and validated.
- Exact iBroadcast append behavior with existing duplicate playlist positions
  remains [unverified](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki/Playlists#appending-and-duplicate-positions).
  Append semantics are unchanged.
- Gapless playback remains experimental and off by default. Unsupported
  transitions use ordinary playback.
